predictions.claim: The paired identity and four-wave normal form retain the reflection-defect term with its minus Im(kappa) Im(Z) sign.
Dividing the actual common pair of zeros removes the rational denominator but does not make the shifted real numerator even about gamma.
For fixed alpha in (0,1/4), the four distinct frequency waves have zero mean and a uniformly positive local second moment, despite the changing phase gamma log(m).
The completed joint negative-part price retains exponent 1/2; this is a certificate obstruction, not a CCM spectral lower bound.
The exact continuous reference has a negligible signed mixed-pair integral but the same half-power pointwise negative-part price; it must be canceled before any local sign cap.
Planted removal of the reflection defect, replacement of kappa by its modulus, or removal of one temporal direction is detected by finite exact algebra.
